front: What is the **moment arm** of a force?
back: The perpendicular distance from the axis to the line of action of the force ($r\sin\theta$).
Two equal, opposite, parallel forces with separated lines of action. Zero resultant force, non-zero torque $Fd$.

front: Two conditions for a rigid body in **equilibrium**?
back: Zero resultant force **and** zero resultant torque about any axis.

Moment of inertia of point masses?
back: $I = \sum mr^2$, in kg m². Depends on the axis and how far the mass is from it.
$\tau = I\alpha$ — resultant torque equals moment of inertia × angular acceleration.

front: Angular momentum and when it is conserved?
back: $L = I\omega$. Conserved when no resultant external torque acts.
$\Delta L = \tau\Delta t$ — the area under a torque–time graph.
